Restricted-PII.handling: Need-to-know access; encrypted storage and transport; exclude from model features and public evidence.

Confidential-Financial.handling: Role-scoped access; KMS encryption; audited reads and writes; no public raw-data publication.

Internal-Reference.handling: Internal analytics use; governed catalog access; publish only aggregated portfolio results.

Public-Portfolio.handling: Approved aggregated metrics, architecture, contracts, synthetic examples, and redacted screenshots only.

retention.raw: Archive after 30/90 days according to the existing lifecycle; noncurrent versions expire after 365 days.
retention.audit: Default 365-day retention, configurable up to 3650 days, with Glacier transition at day 90.
